families.make_source:
def make(n):
    """Return up to 8 calls with distinct valid YMD dates."""
    n = max(1, min(n, 8))
    return [[f"{2000 + i}-01-01"] for i in range(n)]

families.why: The change only reorders the checks and pre‑compiles the patterns. For inputs that match none of the patterns (e.g. a long run of ‘x’ characters) the function still executes three `fullmatch` calls on a string of length n. The extra early `date == "present"` equality test is O(1) and does not offset the three scans.
families.size_meaning: n = length of the bogus string. Cost grows with n because each regex scans the whole string.

def make(n):
    """Return a single call with an invalid string of length n."""
    n = max(1, n)
    return [["x" * n]]
